description: Points one subdomain you choose (like book.yourshop.com) at the pages flomi runs for your business: your booking page, privacy policy and terms. Nothing else on your domain changes.
variableDescription: Pass the subdomain label as the Domain Connect host parameter (book or text). target is the hostname of flomi's pages (currently masa-booking.pages.dev; it changes when our hosting moves accounts), so it is a variable. Requests are always signed (syncPubKeyDomain), so a third party cannot change it.
